description: Needs a subscription. Checks an emitted app before it is built: missing files, altered copy-verbatim files, absent packages, the config merge expo-router needs, and whether the installed Xcode can build the project. Takes the files written with byte sizes, package.json dependencies, project config and toolchain versions.

appId.description: the share code given to emit_app; `appId` in .opointo/files.json

files.description: each file written, the hidden .opointo/files.json included: { path, bytes }, path from the project root

bytes.description: size in bytes on disk as `wc -c` reports, not the character count

sha.description: optional; when sent, the byte check is skipped

expoBuildProperties.description: the INSTALLED expo-build-properties version; omit if absent

expoSdk.description: the INSTALLED expo version, e.g. "56.0.15" (`npm ls expo`)

name: verify_app
title: Verify an emitted app
